notes.title: 🐾 EvoWars - BIG UPDATE: Pets have joined the hunt! ⚔️

notes.title: EvoWars - Balance & Rewards Update! ⚔️💎
notes.notes:
Another round of improvements, fixes, and quality-of-life changes is here. Let’s go! 🚀

[h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] an issue on [b]Steam[/b] where the tutorial would appear every time due to a broken local save.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]incorrect [b]"Champions" stats[/b] in Tournaments.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]a bug where [b]Apache upgrades[/b] showed the wrong currency.
[*] [b]Improved spawn system[/b] - players now avoid dangerous or crowded spawn areas.
[*] [b]Leaderboard[/b] now updates more quickly and accurately.
[*] [b]Monster Hunt summary[/b] now displays properly at the end of the run.
[/list]
[h3]🧬 Evolution System Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Evolutions now reach their[b] maximum size at level 36 (Annihilator).[/b]
[*] [b]Megavolutions[/b] no longer grow in size, but still keep their [b]dual weapon advantage[/b].
[/list]
[u]This change is based on community feedback—early Megavolutions in [b]Teams mode[/b] created an unfair advantage.[/u]

[h3]🛒 Shop & Collections Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Shop[/b] has been separated from [b]Collections.[/b]
[*] The shop now offers [b]timed free rewards [/b]— and they get better the more you claim!
[*] The [b]Premium account[/b] has been renamed to [b]VIP.[/b] 👑
[/list]
[h3]🖱️ UI & Visual Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Custom [b]cursor size reduced by 20%[/b] for better visibility.
[/list]
[h3]⚔️ Duel Mode Reward Boost[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Duel rewards increased [/b]— your[b] 6th win now gives 25 gems [/b]instead of 1! 💎
[/list]
Enjoy the update, and as always — [b]thanks for being part of the EvoWars community! [/b]💬🔥
Let the battles continue! ⚔️

notes.title: ⚔️EvoWars - War Chest & Fair Play Update! 🎁⚔️
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback! This update i[b]mproves War Chest rewards, removes unfair PvP penalties, adds unlimited shard storage,[/b] and[b] introduces a new custom cursor!
[/b]
[h3]War Chest Shard Rewards Increased[/h3]
- War Chest now gives [b]10 to 15 shards[/b] instead of just [b]5![/b]
- Shards are now distributed through [b]special cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]1st-4th cards: [/b]A total of [b]10 shards [/b](collected automatically).
[*] [b]5th card ("Bonus Shards") [/b]contains [b]5 extra shards[/b] and is optional.
[*] [b]Steam & Premium users get it automatically[/b], while free players can collect it by watching an ad.
[/list]
[h3]Shard Storage Limit Removed[/h3]
Previously, you could only hold [b]10 shards per weapon[/b] before getting duplicates. [b]Now, there's no limit! [/b]🎉

[h3]New Custom Cursor[/h3]
- A [b]dedicated graphic cursor[/b] has been added for a better visual experience.
- Prefer the default system cursor? [b]You can disable it in settings!
[/b]
[h3]PvP Balance Fix[/h3]
🚨 [b]Removed the 90% XP & Score penalty[/b] for killing the same player twice within 60s.
✅ [b]Players using Party Code will no longer see each other in Deathmatch mode.[/b]

This update [b]improves progression, removes shard limits, rewards supporters, and enhances the UI![/b] Enjoy the changes and keep evolving! 🔥⚔️

notes.title: EvoWars - War Chest Update! 🎁⚔️
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes to [b]War Chest loot[/b] and game economy! :gem:  [/h3]

[h3][b]War Chest Loot System Rework[/b]  [/h3]
- War Chest now drops [b]shards[/b] for evolutions [b]from level 1 up to your current rank level[/b].  

[i][b]Example:[/b] If your rank is [b]1[/b], War Chest will drop shards only for [b]Caveman evolution[/b].  
If your rank is [b]2[/b], it will drop shards for [b]Caveman or Viking[/b], and so on—up to [b]rank 40[/b], where War Chest can drop shards for [b]all evolutions[/b].[/i]  

[h3][b]What does this change?[/b]  [/h3]
✅ [b]New players[/b] will collect [b]10 shards for the same weapon faster[/b], allowing them to upgrade weapons sooner and progress more quickly.  

✅ [b]Unlocking alternative weapons for higher evolutions[/b] now requires a [b]higher rank[/b], making them a [b]prestigious achievement[/b].  

✅ [b]Rank level now plays a crucial role[/b] in your progression!  

[h3][b]Other Changes & Fixes[/b] [/h3]
- [b]War Chest price reduced[/b] from [b]100 to 25 gems![/b]  
- [b]Tomb spawn chance increased[/b] from [b]3% to 6%![/b]  
- [b]Empower skill now has a max level cap of 20.[/b] 
- [b]Various minor fixes[/b] and improvements.  

Jump in and check out the new system! :fire:  

Let’s Fight! Kill! Evolve! ⚔️
Good Luck & Have Fun! 🎮🔥
